cmd:
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN= /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
D=/opt/trading-bot/classic
cp $D/classic_pos_html.py $D/classic_pos_html.py.bak_before_dd
curl -sfH "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/classic_pos_html.py" -o $D/classic_pos_html.py
chown tbot:tbot $D/classic_pos_html.py
/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile $D/classic_pos_html.py && echo COMPILED
systemctl restart classicbot; sleep 8; systemctl is-active classicbot
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8091/ | grep -c "Макс. просадка"
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8091/api/runs | /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python -c "
import json,sys
for r in json.load(sys.stdin)[\"runs\"]: print(r[\"id\"], \"идёт\" if not r[\"stop_ms\"] else \"стоп\", r[\"stats\"])"
